description.text: The first concept pack of the XY series, released on 30 January 2015, with Team Magma and Team Aqua and the legendary Groudon and Kyogre on the wrapper, as they appear in Pokémon Omega Ruby and Alpha Sapphire. Every Pokémon in it belongs to Team Magma or Team Aqua, and its Trainers and Special Energy are made for them, so a deck for either team can be built from this pack, with basic Energy added. Team Magma's Groudon-EX and Team Aqua's Kyogre-EX are drawn across the whole card with the teams' members and Pokémon. Packs held six cards and a Pokémon Scrap, a code for a mythical Pokémon or items in the 3DS games. The 34 cards are numbered to 34. In English it became Double Crisis in March 2015.
